content.content: The write names the node's document `nodes/<id>.json` under the root: the path S2-path derives from the id alone — no index, no search, no second layout.
content.rationale: S2-path (`pumpuqkv`) fixes the path as `nodes/<id>.json` derived from the id alone, and fixes that it is the path 'a write names under the root'; this node makes the write that namer and fixes that it names it under the root the interfaces are opened on. S2-path is not validating — the id reaches the store already checked (S2-id, `wpxrlzuy`) — so locating stays total. The read names the same path at the owning change (S2-read-at-change, `pxlnolup`); the two differ only in what they name it at, and sit as siblings for it.
